decisions.decision: Use a separate hwm-context transport Issue #27 and separate task-context workflow/runtime instead of reusing historical-ledger transport Issue #2 or widening historical publication schemas.
decisions.rationale: Transport identity, schema validation and authority remain auditable and historical publication stays a closed non-generic boundary.

decisions.decision: Permit only tasks/<IXX-NNNN>/context.json as a regular 100644 add/replace blob whose task, Issue, source tcr1 request, canonical JSON bytes, Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256 all agree.
decisions.rationale: I09-P0 defines context.json as the only v1 artifact; context.md and generic tasks writes would invent contract semantics or arbitrary-writer authority.

decisions.decision: Split publication and strict status authority into separate jobs and modules.
decisions.rationale: The publisher needs minimal contents/PR/issues/actions writes but must not have statuses, merge or approval authority; the protected-main strict gate needs read plus isolated statuses:write and independently revalidates exact Git/PR/CI provenance.

decisions.decision: Narrowly ignore only canonical generated task paths for automatic pull_request CI while preserving ordinary/mixed/wrong-path automatic CI and push-main CI.
decisions.rationale: Generated-only PRs obtain the required check from exact workflow_dispatch plus protected-main strict status without introducing a broad tasks path bypass.

decisions.decision: Validate Git index mode/type in Repository Bootstrap CI in addition to checked-out filesystem shape.
decisions.rationale: This makes symlink, executable, tree and 160000 gitlink/submodule forms fail closed at the repository boundary.

decisions.decision: Treat exact replay as immutable-result reuse and reject same request id with a different normalized fingerprint.
decisions.rationale: This proves no second commit, PR, dispatch or status is created and prevents request-id equivocation.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Extend the historical-ledger request/result contract or turn historical publisher into a generic tasks writer.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Issue #47 requires a forward-only separate task-context publication authority and explicitly forbids historical schema widening.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Give publisher statuses:write, merge, approval, direct-main or bypass authority.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would collapse authority separation and violate protected PR/ruleset semantics.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Publish or merge a production task context pack for Issue #48 during acceptance.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Production materialization belongs to separate downstream Issue #48; all I09-P2 fixtures were disclosure-safe and closed unmerged.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Generate context.md, additional task files, symlinks, executables, submodules or arbitrary tasks paths.
rejected_alternatives.reason: None are canonical hwm-task-context-pack/v1 publication artifacts.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Use PAT, deploy key, GitHub App credential or execute candidate content.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The repository-local built-in GitHub Actions token and inert Git-object validation are sufficient; new credentials or candidate execution would violate the task boundary.
